mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_token (account_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at FROM password_reset_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_token SET used_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
